notes.text: Available in cPanel 70 and later; retrieves resource usage and custom statistics for the selected account. Every row field is optional. maximum=null means an unlimited quota, distinct from maximum=0 and omission; usage remains an integer and no universal resource unit is inferred.

formatter may be null or a string, including a third-party formatter name. Do not infer a closed formatter or resource-id enum. Resource availability depends on server profile and services: filesusage requires the stats-bar File Usage display setting, cachedpostgresdiskusage requires PostgreSQL, mailing_lists requires Mailman, ftp_accounts requires FTP accounts, and mysql_databases requires MySQL.
